span.style: color: light-dark(rgb(28, 43, 51), rgb(192, 205, 212)); font-family: Optimistic, system-ui, -apple-system, "system-ui", ".SFNSText-Regular", sans-serif; text-align: start; white-space-collapse: preserve-breaks; background-color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));
span.span: When training with batch sizes greater than 1 (BS > 1), we need to preload all audio files and concatenate them into a single, long audio sequence. This is necessary because batching audio files of varying lengths is non-trivial. Additionally, we must keep track of each individual audio file's length to facilitate the generation of audio encodings (tokens) for each file during the encoding stage, where the concatenated audio will be split back into individual files.
